QuestInfo.name: What's Next?
QuestInfo.0: Now that his class is over, ask Kimu what's next.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Basic Training site for the second training.

0.0: Whoa, Kinu didn't bore you to death? Well, it still can't have been too good. We'd best do a little physical work to get your heart pumping.

yes.0: You can use the portal on the left side of the map to move to the training area. Follow the signs! I'll be there.

no.0: Are you sure? I was sure you'd be ready for a good workout.

1.0: See what I did there? Now you know how portals work!\r\nYou ready to get some basic training on?
